overrides.tagline: One-click deploy of Microsoft GraphRAG as an Azure Container App with API + UI for knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval

reason: Auto-classifier picked the generic 'rag' category and missed that this is the specific GraphRAG variant (knowledge-graph augmented). 'data' added because the pipeline ingests + indexes documents into a graph store before retrieval. Added 'archived' to tags so the website can surface a maintenance-status badge — the upstream repo was archived 2025-08 in favour of microsoft/graphrag direct usage; the accelerator pattern remains a valuable reference.
